issuer.name: Dollarama Inc.
issuer.comment: A 52 or 53 week retail year is not 12 months. Record the week count. Note 1 (PDF p.12, printed p.5): the fiscal year ends on the Sunday closest to January 31; the year ended February 1, 2026 comprised 52 weeks whereas the comparative year ended February 2, 2025 comprised 53 WEEKS. The prior column is therefore a 53-week period and is not directly comparable to the current 52-week column. SEDAR+ profile number is 000028876 (Dollarama Inc. / Dollarama Inc.); sedar_profile_url is left null because SEDAR+ serves issuer profiles only through session-scoped view-instance URLs that expire, so no durable profile URL exists to record. MATERIAL CHANGE IN SCOPE: on July 21, 2025 the Corporation acquired The Reject Shop Limited (now Dollarama Australia), so fiscal 2026 consolidates an Australian retail segment for the first time. See harvest_log.discrepancies before using this file for a Canadian CCA computation.

filing.document_title: Audited annual financial statements - English.pdf (cover page reads: Dollarama Inc. Consolidated Financial Statements February 1, 2026 and February 2, 2025)
filing.comment: The audited annual consolidated financial statements, not the MD&A and not a press release. Source used: SEDAR+ (route 1 of the brief). Profile 000028876, filing type 'Annual financial statements', document 'Audited annual financial statements - English.pdf', submitted 24 Mar 2026 07:07:55 EDT, principal jurisdiction Quebec, 446 KB. SEDAR+ displays NO accession number for this document anywhere in the search results grid or the document record, so per the brief the permanent document URL generated by SEDAR+ ('Generate URL') is recorded in sedar_accession and copied into every leaf; no accession format was invented. All page references are PDF page numbers in this 62-page document; the printed page number shown in the footer equals the PDF page number minus 7 and is also given in each comment. Pagination was verified against the SEDAR+ copy itself (62 pages, identical page contents), not only against the copy posted on the investor relations site. Auditor's report is dated March 23, 2026, signed at Montreal, Quebec; engagement partner Nochane Rousseau.

credit_facility.rate_basis: Borrowings available in Canadian, Australian or U.S. dollars under the Fifth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, except Facility E where drawdown is limited to Australian dollars with interest calculated on the basis of the prevailing Australian Bank Bill Swap Reference Rate plus the applicable margin. No margin grid or benchmark is disclosed for Facilities A to D.
credit_facility.maturity_date: Facility A June 27, 2030; Facility B June 27, 2028; Facility C June 27, 2028; Facility D June 26, 2026; Facility E December 22, 2026
credit_facility.comment: Printed pages 32 to 33 (PDF pp.39 to 40). NO SINGLE TOTAL LIMIT IS DISCLOSED, so limit is left null rather than summing the facilities. The note gives the facilities individually: Facility A 250,000; Facility B 450,000; Facility C 50,000; Facility D 300,000; and a new Facility E of A$75,000 ($71,093) added on December 22, 2025 with Dollarama Australia as borrower. drawn_at_period_end is 0 because the note states that as at February 1, 2026 and February 2, 2025 no amount was outstanding under the Credit Agreement; 1,118,751 (1,048,627) was available, including letters of credit issued for the purchase of inventories of 2,342 (1,373). Subject to additional commitments the Corporation may request increases up to an aggregate 1,500,000 excluding Facility E. The Credit Agreement requires a minimum interest coverage ratio and a maximum leverage ratio, tested quarterly; the Corporation was in compliance at February 1, 2026. discrepancies: SCOPE, READ THIS BEFORE COMPUTING A CCA SHIELD. Fiscal 2026 is the first year Dollarama consolidates a non-Canadian operating segment. On July 21, 2025 it acquired The Reject Shop Limited, now Dollarama Australia (note 6, PDF p.29). The brief said to stop and report if the issuer turned out to have a large non-Canadian asset base. The harvest was completed because the non-Canadian share is material but not dominant, and the decision is the analyst's, not the harvester's. The measured exposure, all from note 21 (PDF p.60) and note 9 (PDF p.32): Australian total assets 547,424 of 7,558,352 (7.2%); Australian non-current assets 365,336 of 5,920,803 (6.2%); Australian sales 454,827 of 7,255,754 (6.3%, and only from July 22, 2025). Within OWNED property, plant and equipment the acquisition brought in 66,144 of cost, about 2.9% of the 2,271,329 closing cost, plus 5,428 of translation movement; most of the Australian footprint is 402 leased stores that sit in right-of-use assets, which are excluded from the CCA base anyway. The consolidated PP&E base therefore remains roughly 94% Canadian, but a CCA computation run on the consolidated note 9 total is no longer purely Canadian and the piece must either say so or carve the Australian assets out. Note also that the two operating segments face different tax regimes: segment income taxes were 454,876 in Canada and (127) in Australia.

PP&E ROLL-FORWARD, FIELD MAPPING. Note 9 has no 'transfers' line. It has two movement lines the template has no field for: 'Additions from business combination' (66,144 in total) and 'Foreign currency translation adjustments' (5,428 in total), both from the TRS acquisition. Both were carried in 'transfers' so that cost_opening + additions - disposals + transfers ties to cost_closing for every one of the seven rows, and each row's comment gives the verbatim split. 'additions' therefore holds only the note's own 'Additions' line, which keeps it tied to the 248,747 of capex in the cash flow statement. Nothing was merged, renamed or netted.

PP&E ACCUMULATED DEPRECIATION DOES NOT TIE, BY DESIGN. Accumulated depreciation also moved by a foreign currency translation adjustment of 1,481 in total (store and warehouse equipment 650; computer equipment 187; leasehold improvements 644). The template has no field for it, so for those three rows accumulated_depreciation_opening + depreciation_charge - accumulated_depreciation_on_disposals is short of accumulated_depreciation_closing by exactly that amount. Every figure is as printed; nothing was adjusted to force a tie. The four unaffected rows tie exactly, and cost_closing minus accumulated_depreciation_closing equals net_book_value_closing for all seven rows and for the total.

LEASE PAYMENTS ARE NOT SPLIT. cash_flow.payments_of_lease_liabilities_principal holds (390,333) / ((317,829)), the line printed as 'Net payment of lease liabilities'. That is the TOTAL cash paid, inclusive of the interest component: the note 8 reconciliation adds interest expense of 99,087 (86,730) and then deducts this same figure, and interest paid on lease liabilities of 99,087 (86,730) is disclosed as supplemental information under the cash flow statement. The Corporation does not disclose the principal portion, and the harvester did not derive it. Anything downstream that treats this leaf as principal alone will overstate the principal repayment by the interest amount.

BOOK DEPRECIATION HAS THREE DIFFERENT MEASURES IN THIS FILING; income_statement.depreciation_and_amortisation_book holds the face line 429,053 (382,805). TOTAL book depreciation and amortization is 460,019 (411,151) per the cash flow statement, because 30,966 (28,346) of depreciation sits inside cost of sales. Depreciation of OWNED property, plant and equipment alone is 104,806 (116,238) per note 9; the remaining 328,771 (268,843) of the 402,611 (356,735) property and right-of-use depreciation in note 20 is right-of-use asset depreciation per note 8. For a contrast against capital cost allowance on owned depreciable property, 104,806 is the comparable figure, not 429,053 and not 460,019.

SHARE COUNTS MIX SCALES, DELIBERATELY. shares_outstanding_period_end is in WHOLE SHARES (272,929,382) because the share capital note prints it that way; both weighted average leaves are in THOUSANDS (275,611 and 276,684) because the earnings per share note and the face of the income statement print them that way. Per the brief nothing was rescaled; the unit field on the two weighted average leaves was changed to 'shares (thousands)' instead. Dividing net earnings of 1,309,438 (thousands of dollars) by 275,611 (thousands of shares) reproduces the printed basic EPS of $4.75, which confirms the scales are as stated.

DEBT CARRYING AMOUNTS COME FROM TWO TABLES THAT DO NOT ADD TO THE SAME TOTAL. Per-tranche carrying amounts were taken from the fair value table in note 13 and sum to 2,614,145 (2,266,457). debt_note.total_carrying_amount is 2,625,121 (2,282,679), from the first table in the same note, and that is the figure that agrees to the balance sheet: 398,275 + 2,226,846 = 2,625,121. The first table reconciles 2,600,000 of face amounts to that total through unamortized debt issue costs (7,992), accrued interest on the Fixed Rate Notes 20,837, long-term financing arrangements 3,465 and a fair value hedge basis adjustment on an interest rate swap 8,811. The 10,976 gap between the two totals was NOT reconciled by the harvester; both figures are recorded as printed.
